tools.name: activate_view
tools.description: Open a view, sheet or schedule and make it the active view (by name or id; viewType disambiguates names shared by a plan and a ceiling plan), or close an open view. Active document only; view templates can't be opened and the last open view can't be closed. Does not change the model. Returns the active view after the call and the open views.

view.description: View, sheet or schedule name or id (list_views shows them).

viewType.description: Revit view type to disambiguate a name shared by several views (FloorPlan, CeilingPlan, Section, ThreeD, DrawingSheet...).

operation.description: activate (default) opens the view and makes it active; close closes it if it is open (never the last open view).

tools.name: align_viewports
tools.description: Align viewports to a reference viewport, on the same sheet or across sheets. same_model_point puts the same model point at the same paper position (typical for stacked floor plans; warns on different scales or orientations); left/right/top/bottom/center_h/center_v/center align the viewport boxes (box outline in paper mm). Each move is read back. Undo: Ctrl+Z.

reference.description: Reference viewport: viewport id, or the name/id of a view placed on exactly one sheet.

targets.description: Viewports to move (same forms as reference); may be on other sheets. Up to 200.

mode.description: same_model_point (same model point at the same paper position: aligns plans across sheets), left, right, top, bottom (box edges), center_h (same X centre), center_v (same Y centre) or center.

tools.name: apply_view_filter
tools.description: Add, update or remove an existing view filter on views or view templates, with visibility, enabled flag and graphic overrides (line colors/weight, surface/cut patterns and colors, transparency, halftone; "solid" = solid fill). Views whose filters are controlled by a template are refused with the template name (target the template). State is read back. Undo: Ctrl+Z.

targets.description: Views or view templates (names or ids), up to 200.

filter.description: View filter (rule-based or selection filter) name or id.

action.description: add (default; updates if already applied), update (must already be applied) or remove.

visible.description: Whether elements passing the filter are visible.

enabled.description: Whether the filter is enabled in the view.

overrides.description: Graphic overrides for the filter (only the given fields change).

surfaceColor.description: Surface foreground pattern color as "#RRGGBB" (needs a surfacePattern, e.g. "solid").

surfacePattern.description: Surface foreground fill pattern name or id; "solid" for the solid fill; "none" to clear.

cutPattern.description: Cut foreground fill pattern name or id; "solid" for the solid fill; "none" to clear.

atomic.description: true (default): any target that fails rolls the whole call back. false: failures are reported per target.

tools.name: apply_view_template
tools.description: Assign a view template to views (mode assign: stays linked), apply its settings once without linking (mode apply_once), or remove the template (template "none"). Compatibility is checked per view (IsValidViewTemplate) and the result read back with the previous template, so the call can be reverted. Atomic by default. Undo: Ctrl+Z, or call again with the returned before values.

template.description: View template name or id, or "none" to remove the template from the views.

mode.description: assign (default): the view stays linked to the template. apply_once: copy the template's settings once, without linking.

atomic.description: true (default): any incompatible view rolls the whole call back. false: incompatible views are reported in failed[].

tools.name: assign_material
tools.description: Apply a material to elements — "trocar acabamento": on a layer of a wall/floor/ceiling/roof type (by index, or by function such as finish1 on the exterior/interior side) or on a material parameter. A type change DUPLICATES the type by default ("{type} - {material}", reused when an identical one exists) and switches only the given elements to it; typeMutation inPlace edits the type for all its instances, deny refuses. Results are read back per type. Preview with dryRun:true (no approval), then run (needs approval). Undo: Ctrl+Z.

elementIds.description: Elements to change (walls, floors, ceilings, roofs for target=layer; any element for target=parameter).

material.description: Material to apply: name or id.

target.description: layer (default): a layer of the type's structure ("trocar acabamento"). parameter: a material parameter of the element or its type.

layerIndex.description: target=layer: exact layer index (see get_compound_structure). Alternative to layerFunction.

layerFunction.description: target=layer: which layer by function (default finish1 = the finish).

side.description: target=layer with layerFunction: exterior (default; top for floors) takes the first matching layer, interior (bottom) the last.

parameter.description: target=parameter: the material parameter ({builtIn} | {name} | {guid}), searched on the instance, then the type.

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

typeMutation.description: When the change is on the type: duplicate (default; a new type is created and ONLY these elements switch to it), inPlace (edit the type: every instance changes) or deny (fail).

newTypeName.description: Name pattern of duplicated types; {type} = original type name, {material} = material name. Default "{type} - {material}". An existing type with that name and the same result is reused.

tools.name: assign_revision_to_sheets
tools.description: Add a revision to sheets, or remove it (manual assignment, no cloud). The sheet's existing manual revisions are kept (read, merge, write); sheets that already have it are reported as unchanged; revisions that come from clouds cannot be removed this way. Read back per sheet. Undo: Ctrl+Z or call again with the opposite mode.

revision.description: Revision: element id, "#N" / "seq:N" for sequence number N, or its description.

sheets.description: Sheets (numbers, names or ids), up to 1000.

mode.description: add (default) or remove. Only manual assignments can be removed; revisions that come from clouds stay.

atomic.description: true (default): any sheet that fails rolls the whole call back. false: failures are reported per sheet.

tools.name: audit_families
tools.description: Audit the loaded families: unused ones (Purge Unused list), in-place families, near-duplicate names ("Porta 80" vs "Porta 80 2" / "(1)" / "copy"), families with too many types, and optionally geometric complexity (solids/faces of one sample instance per family, within timeBudgetMs). Counts per section and family ids/names. Read-only: use purge_unused to remove.

sections.description: What to audit (default unused, inPlace, duplicateNames, manyTypes): unused, inPlace, duplicateNames, manyTypes, complexity (slow).

categories.description: Only families of these categories (any language). Default: all loadable families.

typeCountThreshold.description: manyTypes: report families with more types than this, 1-1000 (default 30).

limit.description: Items listed per section, 1-2000 (default 100); counts are always complete.

timeBudgetMs.description: complexity: stop sampling after this many milliseconds, 1000-300000 (default 20000).

tools.name: audit_sheets_views
tools.description: Audit sheets and views: views and schedules not placed on any sheet (templates, dependent working views and excludeViewNames ignored), schedules with no rows, sheets with no views, sheets without a title block, and sheets missing required parameters (drawn by, checked by, issue date by default). Counts per section plus ids/names. Read-only: nothing is deleted.

sections.description: What to audit (default all): unplacedViews, unplacedSchedules, emptySchedules, emptySheets, sheetsWithoutTitleBlock, sheetParameters.

requiredSheetParameters.description: Sheet parameters that must have a value (e.g. "Desenhado por", {builtIn: SHEET_DRAWN_BY}). Default: drawn by, checked by, issue date.

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

excludeViewNames.description: Regex: views whose name matches are ignored (working views), e.g. "^(WORK|TRAB|x_)".

limit.description: Items listed per section, 1-2000 (default 100); counts are always complete.

tools.name: bind_shared_parameter
tools.description: Bind a shared parameter (by guid, or unique name, from the shared parameter file configured in Revit or one in the allowed folders) to categories as an instance or type parameter, in a properties group. mode add / addCategories / rebind (rebind can change kind and group; removing categories drops their values). Categories that don't accept parameters are refused. Project-only (non-shared) parameters are not created here. Check first with list_parameter_bindings. Needs approval. Undo: Ctrl+Z.

guid.description: GUID of the shared parameter in the shared parameter file (preferred).

name.description: Name of the shared parameter, when no guid is given (must be unique in the file).

sharedParameterFile.description: Shared parameter .txt file to read, inside the allowed folders. Default: the file configured in Revit (left unchanged).

categories.description: Categories to bind to, in any language (OST_Doors, Doors, Portas).

group.description: Properties palette group: label as Revit shows it ("Dados", "Identity Data"), short name (data, identity_data) or GroupTypeId. Default Data for new bindings; kept for existing ones unless given.

mode.description: add (default): fails if already bound. addCategories: add these categories to the existing binding. rebind: replace categories, kind and group.

varyByGroup.description: Instance bindings only: allow values to vary between group instances.

tools.name: bulk_update_parameters
tools.description: Apply one change to a parameter on every element that matches a scope: explicit elementIds, categories (any language) narrowed by view and where[] conditions, or the current selection. Operations: set, prefix, suffix, findReplace, regexReplace, clear, copyFrom another parameter; onlyEmpty skips filled values. ALWAYS call it first with dryRun:true (no approval needed) to get matched/skipped counts and a before/after sample, then run it for real (needs approval). Numbers in wire units (mm, m2, m3, deg, %). Every write is read back; atomic by default. Undo: Ctrl+Z or send revert[] to set_parameters / set_type_parameters.

elementIds.description: Explicit elements (ids or UniqueIds as strings). Alternative to categories / useSelection.

categories.description: Categories in any language (OST_Doors, Doors, Portas): every element of these categories, narrowed by view and where[].

view.description: Only elements visible in this view (name or id). Used with categories.

useSelection.description: Act on Revit's current selection (target must be the active document). Default false.

where.description: Extra conditions on parameters, all must match (same operators as find_elements).

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

op.description: Operator (default eq). Text compares ignore case and accents; numbers compare in wire units (mm, m2, m3, deg, %).

value.description: Value to compare with (not needed for is_empty / not_empty).

scope.description: Where to read the parameter: auto (instance, then type; default), instance or type.

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

target.description: Where the parameter lives: instance (default), type (writes each distinct type once; affects all its instances) or auto (instance, then type).

operation.description: set (value), prefix / suffix (value added to the current text, with separator), findReplace (find → replace, plain text), regexReplace (find is a .NET regex, replace may use $1), clear, copyFrom (value of sourceParameter on the same element).

value.description: For set: the value (numbers in wire units mm, m2, m3, deg, %; ElementId parameters by id or name). For prefix/suffix: the text to add.

unit.description: Optional unit override for a numeric set value: m, cm, mm, ft, in, m2, ft2, m3, l, deg, rad, %, ratio or internal.

find.description: Text (findReplace) or regular expression (regexReplace) to look for.

replace.description: Replacement text for findReplace / regexReplace (default empty).

separator.description: Text between the current value and the prefix/suffix (default none).

ignoreCase.description: findReplace / regexReplace ignore case. Default false.

sourceParameter.description: For copyFrom: the parameter to read on each element (instance first, then type).

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

onlyEmpty.description: Only write elements whose parameter is currently empty. Default false.

maxElements.description: Safety limit: refuse when more elements than this would be written (default 500, max 2000).

sampleSize.description: How many before/after rows to return (default 20).

atomic.description: true (default): any invalid item or read-back mismatch rolls everything back. false: write what can be written and report the rest.

allowCritical.description: Allow critical parameters (type, level, phase, workset, host; one Mark on many elements). Default false.

tools.name: capture_view_image
tools.description: Render a view or sheet to an image (png default, or jpg) at widthPx pixels, saved under the allowed output folder (Documents\RevitMCP\captures) with a unique name, and return it inline as an image so the model can be looked at; also returns the file path. Without view, captures the active view of the target document when it is the active one. Does not change the model.

view.description: View or sheet (name or id). Omit for the active view (only when the target document is the active one).

returnInline.description: Return the image itself to the client (default true; images over 4 MB are only saved). false: only save the file and return its path.

tools.name: change_element_type
tools.description: Change the type of specific elements (instances, tags, section views...) to a type given by id, "Family: Type" or name, or to the type of another element (matchFromElementId = Match Type). Each element is checked against the types Revit allows for it (same category/class); the old and new type are read back per element. For every instance of a type use replace_type_instances. Undo: Ctrl+Z, or call again with the returned old types.

elementIds.description: Elements whose type changes (instances, tags, views...).

targetType.description: New type: id, "Family: Type" or type name (searched in the elements' category).

matchFromElementId.description: Alternative to targetType: use the type of this element (Match Type).

atomic.description: true (default): if any element can't take the type, nothing changes. false: change the others and report the failures.

tools.name: check_clashes
tools.description: Detect clashes between set A and set B (or A against itself): each set by categories, explicit element ids and/or a Revit link. solid mode computes the real intersection volume (m3) and centre (mm) of each clashing pair; bbox mode only compares bounding boxes. Joined and host/hosted pairs are skipped by default. Bounded by maxPairs and timeBudgetMs (truncated says so). Read-only.

categories.description: Categories in any language (OST_Ducts / Ducts / Dutos). With link, taken from the linked model.

elementIds.description: Explicit elements: id, UniqueId or "linkInstanceId:elementId" for linked elements.

link.description: Revit link instance id or name: take the categories from that linked model instead of the host.

setB.description: Second set. Omit to check set A against itself.

categories.description: Categories in any language (OST_Ducts / Ducts / Dutos). With link, taken from the linked model.

elementIds.description: Explicit elements: id, UniqueId or "linkInstanceId:elementId" for linked elements.

link.description: Revit link instance id or name: take the categories from that linked model instead of the host.

mode.description: solid (default): real intersection volume of the solids; bbox: bounding boxes only (fast, many false positives).

tolerance.description: Grow the bounding boxes by this much before comparing (bbox mode and pre-filter). Default 0. Unit: mm.

minVolume.description: solid mode: ignore intersections smaller than this (default 0.0001 m3 = 100 cm3; 0 keeps every touch).

ignoreJoined.description: Skip pairs joined with Join Geometry and host/hosted pairs (door in its wall). Default true.

maxElementsPerSet.description: Refuse sets larger than this, 1-50000 (default 10000); narrow the categories or use a link/elementIds.

timeBudgetMs.description: Stop after this many milliseconds and return what was found (truncated), 1000-600000 (default 30000).

tools.name: check_levels_grids
tools.description: Check levels and grids: levels at the same elevation (within tolerance, mm), building-story levels without a floor plan (or ceiling plan), duplicated or overlapping grids (same line/arc within tolerance) and straight grids slightly off the orthogonal axes. Lists every level with its elevation in mm. Read-only.

tolerance.description: Distance under which two levels or grids count as duplicated/overlapping (default 1 mm).

requireFloorPlan.description: Report building-story levels with no floor plan (default true).

requireCeilingPlan.description: Report building-story levels with no ceiling plan (default false).

offAxisAngle.description: Report straight grids that are off the orthogonal axes by more than 0.001 deg but less than this (default 1 deg): usually drawing mistakes.

tools.name: check_naming
tools.description: Check view names, sheet numbers, level names and family type names against the office naming convention (read from knowledge/nomenclatura.md and folhas.md 'Formato:' lines, or explicit regexes in patterns) and for hygiene problems ("Copy"/"Cópia"/"(2)" leftovers, double or trailing spaces). Returns the rules used and offending names with the problems and a cleaned-up suggestion when one is obvious. Read-only: rename with the renaming tools.

kinds.description: What to check (default views, sheets, levels): views, sheets, levels, types.

patterns.description: Override the convention with explicit regexes. Default: the office convention in knowledge/nomenclatura.md and folhas.md (REVIT_MCP_KNOWLEDGE_DIR or Documents\RevitMCP\knowledge), else hygiene checks only.

views.description: Regex every view name must match.

sheets.description: Regex every sheet number must match.

levels.description: Regex every level name must match.

types.description: Regex every family type name must match.

limit.description: Offending names listed per kind, 1-2000 (default 100); counts are always complete.

tools.name: check_required_parameters
tools.description: Check parameter rules per category: required parameters that are empty, values that must be unique (duplicate door/window Marks, room Numbers) and values that must match a regex. Without rules it checks the defaults (doors/windows: unique Mark; rooms: Name and unique Number). Returns violation groups with counts and element ids; fix them with set_parameters. Read-only.

rules.description: Rules to check. Omit for the defaults: doors and windows need a unique Mark; rooms need a Name and a unique Number.

categories.description: Categories the rule applies to, any language (OST_Doors / Doors / Portas).

required.description: Parameters that must have a value (instance first, then type).

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

unique.description: Parameters whose non-empty values must be unique within each category (e.g. Mark, room Number).

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

patterns.description: Parameters whose values must match a regex.

parameter.description: Parameter to check: {guid} | {builtIn} | {name} or a plain name.

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

regex.description: Regular expression the (non-empty) value must match, e.g. "^P\\d{2}$".

view.description: Only elements visible in this view (name or id). Default: the whole model.

maxItemsPerGroup.description: Element ids listed per violation group, 1-1000 (default 50); counts are always complete.

tools.name: clear_graphic_overrides
tools.description: Clear graphic overrides in a view: of given elements, of given categories (any language), or of every element in the view (all) and optionally every category (allCategories); optionally unhide them too. View filter overrides are not touched (set_view_filter). Returns how many elements/categories were reset. Undo: Ctrl+Z.

view.description: View (name or id).

elementIds.description: Elements whose overrides are cleared.

categories.description: Categories whose overrides are cleared, in any language.

all.description: Clear every element override in the view (and every category override when allCategories). Default false.

allCategories.description: With all: also clear every category override of the view (default false).

unhide.description: Also unhide the given elements/categories (default false).

tools.name: color_elements_by_parameter
tools.description: Colour the elements of some categories visible in a view by the value of a parameter (instance, then type): distinct palette colours per value, an explicit colorMap {value: "#RRGGBB"}, or a gradient for numeric values (sorted numerically). Colours surfaces (solid fill), lines, or both, merging with existing overrides. Returns the legend: value, colour, element count. Undo: Ctrl+Z or clear_graphic_overrides.

view.description: View (name or id) where the colours are applied.

categories.description: Categories to colour, in any language (OST_Walls, Walls, Paredes).

parameter.description: Parameter whose value picks the colour: {builtIn} | {guid} | {name}; read on the instance, then on its type.

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

colorMap.description: Explicit colours by value, e.g. {"Demolir": "#FF0000"} (value as Revit displays it, or the wire value; case and accents ignored). Other values get palette colours unless onlyMapped.

gradient.description: For numeric parameters: interpolate from/to colours between the smallest and largest value instead of a palette.

onlyMapped.description: Colour only the values listed in colorMap (default false).

noValueColor.description: Colour for elements without the parameter or with an empty value. Default: leave them as they are.

target.description: What to colour: surface (default, solid foreground fill of surfaces and cuts), lines, or both.

elementIds.description: Only these elements (ids) among those visible in the view.

tools.name: compute_room_finishes
tools.description: Compute finishes per room: floor, wall and ceiling areas in m2 grouped by the material of the bounding element's face and its type (from Revit's room geometry, finish faces), plus room area (m2) and perimeter (mm) for skirting, and totals per material for the page. Openings are not deducted beyond what Revit's room geometry already excludes. Rooms that are not enclosed are listed with the error. Read-only.

roomIds.description: Rooms to compute. Omit to use every placed room (optionally of one level).

level.description: Only rooms of this level (name or id).

tools.name: copy_parameters
tools.description: Copy parameter values from one source element to 1..500 target elements (match properties). Copies the listed parameters, or every editable parameter they share; only when storage and data type match (any value can go into a text parameter). Measures are copied exactly in internal units. scope=type copies type parameters onto the targets' types. mapping renames parameters between categories. Skipped pairs are reported with a reason. Read-back and revert[] as set_parameters. Undo: Ctrl+Z or send revert[] to set_parameters / set_type_parameters.

sourceElementId.description: Element to copy from (id or UniqueId).

targetElementIds.description: Elements to copy to (ids or UniqueIds).

parameters.description: Parameters to copy, each {guid} | {builtIn} | {name}. Omit to copy every editable parameter the elements share (Mark, IFC GUIDs and critical parameters are left out).

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

scope.description: instance (default): instance parameters onto the targets. type: type parameters of the source's type onto each target's type (affects all their instances). both.

mapping.description: Optional renames for other categories: {"source parameter name": "target parameter name"}.

atomic.description: true (default): any refused write rolls everything back. false: copy what can be copied.

allowCritical.description: Allow critical parameters (level, phase, workset, host...) when listed explicitly. Default false.

tools.name: create_area
tools.description: Create areas (for area schedules / quadro de áreas) in the area plan of a scheme and level, creating that area plan if missing. Each item is a point inside an existing boundary, or a closed outline in mm that is first drawn as area boundary lines. Read-back: area in m², name, number, and a warning when it is not enclosed. One Ctrl+Z undoes the call.

areaScheme.description: Area scheme by name or id (e.g. "Área bruta" / "Gross Building"). Required when the document has more than one.

level.description: Level by name or id.

areaPlan.description: Area plan view by name or id. Default: the area plan of this scheme and level.

createAreaPlanIfMissing.description: Create the area plan for this scheme and level when there is none. Default true.

point.description: Plan point in mm inside the area. Optional when boundary is given (its centre is used).

x.description: X coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

y.description: Y coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

boundary.description: Closed outline in mm: area boundary lines are drawn along it before placing the area.

x.description: X coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

y.description: Y coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

name.description: Area name.

tools.name: create_callout_view
tools.description: Create a callout view inside a parent view (plan, section, elevation, detail), framed by a model-XY rectangle in mm (plans) or by elements plus padding mm (any parent; corners are projected through the parent's view transform). kind plan (cropped plan, plan parents) or detail. Optional name, scale (20 = 1:20), detail level, template. The callout's crop is read back. Undo: Ctrl+Z or delete the returned view id.

parentView.description: View (name or id) the callout is drawn in: a plan, section, elevation or detail view.

rect.description: Callout rectangle in model XY (mm). Plans only; for sections/elevations use fitElementIds.

x.description: X coordinate in mm (project internal origin).

y.description: Y coordinate in mm (project internal origin).

x.description: X coordinate in mm (project internal origin).

y.description: Y coordinate in mm (project internal origin).

fitElementIds.description: Element ids to frame instead of rect: the callout covers their extents as seen in the parent view, plus padding.

kind.description: plan = callout of the same family as a plan parent (a cropped plan); detail = detail view. Default: plan for plan parents, detail otherwise.

viewFamilyType.description: View type name or id for the callout; overrides kind.

name.description: Callout view name (must be free). Omit for Revit's default name.

template.description: View template name or id to assign.

tools.name: create_ceiling
tools.description: Create ceilings (forros) from a polygon in mm (with holes), a rectangle, or a room's boundary (inner finish face by default, optional boundaryOffset, e.g. -10 for a shadow gap). The ceiling type must be named; heightAboveLevel (mm) goes to 'Height Offset From Level'. Needs Revit 2022+. Every ceiling is read back (id, area m², height). One Ctrl+Z undoes the call.

boundary.description: Outline: points (+holes), rectangle, or a room (inner finish face by default).

points.description: Closed outline as plan points in mm (the last point connects back to the first; do not repeat the first point).

x.description: X coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

y.description: Y coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

origin.description: Corner the rectangle starts from (before rotation), in mm.

x.description: X coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

y.description: Y coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

width.description: Size along X (before rotation), in mm.

depth.description: Size along Y (before rotation), in mm.

rotation.description: Counter-clockwise rotation around the origin corner, in degrees. Default 0.

holes.description: Openings inside the outline (shafts, cut-outs). Only with points/rectangle.

points.description: Closed list of plan points in mm (do not repeat the first point).

x.description: X coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

y.description: Y coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

room.description: Room whose boundary is used, by element id, room number or room name (ambiguous names fail with the candidates).

boundaryLocation.description: With room: which wall line bounds the outline. finish (default) = inner finish face of the walls; center = wall centreline; coreBoundary / coreCenter = wall core.

boundaryOffset.description: Grows (positive) or shrinks (negative) the whole outline, holes included, in mm. E.g. -10 leaves a 10 mm gap to the walls.

ceilingType.description: Ceiling type as "Family: Type", type name or id. Required: never chosen for you.

level.description: Level the height is measured from, by name or id. Optional with boundary.room (defaults to the room's level).

heightAboveLevel.description: Height of the ceiling above the level in mm (Revit's 'Height Offset From Level'), e.g. 2600.

continueOnError.description: false (default): any failure rolls back the whole call. true: failed items are skipped and listed in failed[].

tools.name: create_countertop
tools.description: Create a stone countertop (tampo) from a plan outline or rectangle in mm: top surface height above the level, thickness, rectangular cut-outs (sink/cooktop), optional front apron (saia) and backsplash (rodabanca) on chosen edges. method floor uses a named floor type (thickness must match) so it schedules as a floor; method directshape builds a Generic Model solid with a material. Returns ids, area (m²) and volume (m³). One Ctrl+Z undoes the call.

points.description: Outline of the countertop in plan, mm (give points or rectangle). Edge i runs from point i to point i+1 (the last edge closes the outline).

x.description: X coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

y.description: Y coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

rectangle.description: Rectangular outline. Edges: 0 = from the origin along width (front), 1 = right side, 2 = back, 3 = left side (before rotation).

origin.description: Corner the rectangle starts from (before rotation), in mm.

x.description: X coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

y.description: Y coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

width.description: Size along X (before rotation), in mm.

depth.description: Size along Y (before rotation), in mm.

rotation.description: Counter-clockwise rotation around the origin corner, in degrees. Default 0.

level.description: Level by name or id.

height.description: Height of the top surface above the level in mm (e.g. 900 kitchen, 800 bathroom).

thickness.description: Stone thickness in mm (e.g. 20 or 30). With method floor it must match the floor type's thickness.

method.description: floor: a floor of the named floorType (schedulable as a floor). directshape: a Generic Model solid with the given material.

floorType.description: method floor: floor type for the top (e.g. "Tampo granito 20 mm").

material.description: Material by name or id for the directshape parts (top with method directshape, apron and backsplash with both methods).

cutouts.description: Rectangular cut-outs through the top (sink, cooktop).

center.description: Centre of the cut-out (sink/cooktop) in plan, mm.

x.description: X coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

y.description: Y coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

width.description: Cut-out size along X before rotation, mm.

depth.description: Cut-out size along Y before rotation, mm.

frontEdges.description: Edge indexes that get a front apron (saia). Default none.

apronHeight.description: Total visible height of the front apron in mm, top thickness included (e.g. 40). Needs frontEdges.

backsplashEdges.description: Edge indexes that get a backsplash (rodabanca/frontão). Default none.

backsplashHeight.description: Backsplash height above the top in mm (e.g. 100). Needs backsplashEdges.

tools.name: create_elevation_view
tools.description: Place an elevation marker on a plan at a point (mm) and create 1-4 elevations by the direction the camera looks to (north = +Y, east = +X of the model). Each view's real direction is read back. Optional view type (e.g. interior elevation), scale, name pattern with {dir}, template, and crop to elements (fitElementIds + padding mm, e.g. a room). Undo: Ctrl+Z or delete the returned view ids.

plan.description: Floor/ceiling plan (name or id) where the elevation marker is placed.

point.description: Marker position in plan, mm (project internal origin).

x.description: X coordinate in mm (project internal origin).

y.description: Y coordinate in mm (project internal origin).

directions.description: Directions the cameras look to (model axes: north = +Y, east = +X). Default all four. An interior elevation of the north wall looks north; an exterior 'north facade' elevation looks south.

viewFamilyType.description: Elevation view type name or id (e.g. an interior elevation type). Omit for the default elevation type.

scale.description: Scale denominator (50 = 1:50). Default: the plan's scale.

namePattern.description: Name pattern with {dir} (N/S/E/W) and {direction} (north...), e.g. "Elev. hall - {dir}". Collisions get " (2)". Omit for Revit's default names.

template.description: View template name or id to assign to every elevation.

fitElementIds.description: Optional element ids (e.g. a room): each elevation is cropped to their extents seen from its direction, far clip included.

padding.description: Margin around fitElementIds for the crop, in mm (default 300).

tools.name: create_floor
tools.description: Create floors (slabs or finish floors) from a polygon in mm (with holes), a rectangle, or a room's boundary (inner finish face by default, optional boundaryOffset). The floor type must be named. heightOffset (mm) is written to 'Height Offset From Level', not baked into the outline. Every floor is read back (id, area m², thickness, offset). One Ctrl+Z undoes the call.

boundary.description: Outline: points (+holes), rectangle, or a room (inner finish face by default).

points.description: Closed outline as plan points in mm (the last point connects back to the first; do not repeat the first point).

x.description: X coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

y.description: Y coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

origin.description: Corner the rectangle starts from (before rotation), in mm.

x.description: X coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

y.description: Y coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

width.description: Size along X (before rotation), in mm.

depth.description: Size along Y (before rotation), in mm.

rotation.description: Counter-clockwise rotation around the origin corner, in degrees. Default 0.

holes.description: Openings inside the outline (shafts, cut-outs). Only with points/rectangle.

points.description: Closed list of plan points in mm (do not repeat the first point).

x.description: X coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

y.description: Y coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

room.description: Room whose boundary is used, by element id, room number or room name (ambiguous names fail with the candidates).

boundaryLocation.description: With room: which wall line bounds the outline. finish (default) = inner finish face of the walls; center = wall centreline; coreBoundary / coreCenter = wall core.

boundaryOffset.description: Grows (positive) or shrinks (negative) the whole outline, holes included, in mm. E.g. -10 leaves a 10 mm gap to the walls.

floorType.description: Floor type as "Family: Type", type name or id. Required: never chosen for you.

level.description: Level by name or id. Optional with boundary.room (defaults to the room's level); required otherwise.

heightOffset.description: Height offset of the top of the floor from the level, in mm (Revit's 'Height Offset From Level'). Default 0.

structural.description: Mark the floor as structural. Default false.

continueOnError.description: false (default): any failure rolls back the whole call. true: failed items are skipped and listed in failed[].

tools.name: create_material
tools.description: Create a material (new or duplicated from another, with its own copy of the appearance asset) and set class, shading color (#RRGGBB), transparency, shininess, smoothness, surface/cut patterns and colors, and optionally the render appearance color. ifExists=reuse returns the existing material of that name. Values are read back. Undo: Ctrl+Z.

useRenderAppearance.description: Use the render appearance for shading.

surfaceForegroundPattern.description: Surface foreground fill pattern: name or id, "solid", "none"; prefix "model:" / "drafting:" if the name exists in both.

surfaceBackgroundPattern.description: Surface background fill pattern (name, id, "solid" or "none").

cutForegroundPattern.description: Cut foreground fill pattern (name, id, "solid" or "none").

cutBackgroundPattern.description: Cut background fill pattern (name, id, "solid" or "none").

appearanceColor.description: Render appearance color "#RRGGBB" (generic diffuse). Edits the appearance asset; a shared asset is duplicated first.

name.description: Name of the new material (unique in the project).

duplicateFrom.description: Existing material (name or id) to copy; its appearance asset is duplicated too so later edits don't leak.

ifExists.description: When a material with this name exists: error (default) or reuse it (the graphics given are then applied to it).

tools.name: create_or_update_levels
tools.description: Create levels or update existing ones (upsert by name, or rename an existing level given in level): elevation in mm, optional floor plan and ceiling plan. Names are checked for forbidden characters and collisions and read back. Changing an elevation moves everything on that level; the result lists how many elements and views depend on it. Plan views are not renamed. One Ctrl+Z undoes the call.

name.description: Level name. If a level with this name exists it is updated, otherwise created (unless level is given).

level.description: Existing level to update (name or id); it is renamed to name. Omit to match by name.

elevation.description: Elevation in mm, as shown on the level head (relative to the level type's elevation base). Required to create.

createPlanView.description: Create a floor plan for the level if it has none. Default: true for new levels, false for existing ones.

createCeilingPlan.description: Create a reflected ceiling plan for the level if it has none. Default false.

floorPlanType.description: Floor plan view type for new plans, by name. Default: the document's default floor plan type.

ceilingPlanType.description: Ceiling plan view type for new plans, by name. Default: the document's default ceiling plan type.

tools.name: create_revision
tools.description: Create revisions (description, date text, issued by/to, numbering sequence, visibility, issued flag set last) and optionally add them to sheets without clouds. Each field is read back. Undo: Ctrl+Z or delete the returned revision ids (issued revisions must be un-issued first).

items.description: Revisions to create, in order, up to 50.

date.description: Revision date as text, as it should appear (e.g. "17/10/2026").

numberingSequence.description: Revision numbering sequence name or id. Omit for the default.

issued.description: Mark as issued (locks the revision; default false). Set last.

assignToSheets.description: Sheets (numbers, names or ids) that get every new revision (manual assignment, no cloud).

tools.name: create_room_envelope
tools.description: Close rooms in one go: finish floor and ceiling over each room's inner outline, baseboard (rodapé) and ceiling trim (tabica) along its perimeter, each with an explicitly named type. Parts already present (a floor/ceiling over the room) are skipped by default. A failing part does not stop the others: every room reports created/skipped/failed per part with ids. Run with dryRun first to show the plan. One Ctrl+Z undoes the whole call.

rooms.description: Rooms by id, number or name. Give rooms or level.

level.description: All placed rooms of this level (name or id). Give rooms or level.

floorFinish.description: Finish floor (piso de acabamento) over the room's inner outline.

floorType.description: Finish floor type ("Family: Type", name or id), e.g. "Piso porcelanato 10 mm".

heightOffset.description: Top of the finish above the room's level in mm. Default 0 (level = finished floor).

boundaryOffset.description: Grow (+) or shrink (-) the room outline in mm. Default 0.

ceiling.description: Ceiling (forro) over the room's inner outline.

ceilingType.description: Ceiling type ("Family: Type", name or id), e.g. "Forro de gesso 12,5 mm".

heightAboveLevel.description: Ceiling height above the room's level in mm, e.g. 2600.

boundaryOffset.description: Grow (+) or shrink (-) the room outline in mm, e.g. -10 for a shadow gap. Default 0.

baseboard.description: Baseboard (rodapé) along the perimeter, interrupted at doors.

method.description: line_family (exact per room, cut at openings) or wall_sweep (whole wall, cut by inserts).

type.description: Line-based family type, or wall sweep type for wall_sweep.

elevation.description: Height above the room's level in mm. Default: 0 for the baseboard, the ceiling height for the trim.

reverseDirection.description: line_family: flip which side the profile sticks out. Default false.

ceilingTrim.description: Ceiling trim (tabica) along the perimeter at the ceiling line.

method.description: line_family (exact per room, cut at openings) or wall_sweep (whole wall, cut by inserts).

type.description: Line-based family type, or wall sweep type for wall_sweep.

elevation.description: Height above the room's level in mm. Default: 0 for the baseboard, the ceiling height for the trim.

reverseDirection.description: line_family: flip which side the profile sticks out. Default false.

existing.description: skip (default): rooms that already have a floor / ceiling over them do not get another. create: add anyway.

tools.name: create_room_perimeter_profile
tools.description: Run a baseboard (rodapé) or ceiling trim (tabica) along the perimeter of rooms, skipping door openings and room separation lines. method line_family places a line-based family per boundary piece (exact per room); method wall_sweep adds a wall sweep on the room side of each wall (whole wall, cut by inserts). Ceiling trims default to the height of the ceiling over the room. Returns ids and total length (m) per room. One Ctrl+Z undoes the call.

rooms.description: Rooms by id, number or name. Give rooms or level.

level.description: All placed rooms of this level (name or id). Give rooms or level.

kind.description: baseboard = rodapé at the floor; ceiling_trim = tabica/moldura at the ceiling line.

method.description: line_family: line-based family instances on each boundary piece, interrupted at openings (exact per room). wall_sweep: a wall sweep on the room side of each bounding wall (runs the whole wall; cut by doors).

type.description: line_family: line-based family type ("Family: Type"), e.g. the office's rodapé family. wall_sweep: wall sweep type name.

elevation.description: Height of the profile above the room's level in mm. Default: 0 for baseboard; the height of the ceiling over the room for ceiling_trim.

boundaryLocation.description: Which wall line the profile follows. Default finish (inner face of the walls).

skipOpenings.description: Interrupt the profile where a door/opening crosses its height. Default true.

skipSeparationLines.description: No profile along room separation lines (there is no wall). Default true.

minSegment.description: Pieces shorter than this (mm) are skipped. Default 50.

reverseDirection.description: line_family: draw each piece the other way, which flips which side the profile sticks out. Default false (room on the left of each line).

continueOnError.description: false (default): a failing room rolls back the call. true: failing rooms are listed in failed[].

tools.name: create_room_separation_lines
tools.description: Create room separation lines on a level (to split open areas or close rooms without walls), from a polyline of points or a list of segments, in mm. Drawn in a floor plan of that level (named, or the only one). Returns the line ids. One Ctrl+Z undoes the call.

level.description: Level by name or id.

view.description: Floor plan of that level to draw in, by name or id. Default: the level's floor plan when there is exactly one.

points.description: Polyline of plan points in mm (consecutive points are joined). Give points or segments.

x.description: X coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

y.description: Y coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

closed.description: With points: also join the last point to the first. Default false.

x.description: X coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

y.description: Y coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

x.description: X coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

y.description: Y coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

tools.name: create_room_views
tools.description: Room documentation views in bulk: for each room (ids, a level, or all) create a floor plan cropped to the room (+ padding mm) and/or interior elevations from a marker at the room's location point, each cropped to the room and far-clipped beyond its walls. Directions are the way the camera looks (north = +Y). Name patterns with {number}, {name}, {level}, {dir}; scales (50 = 1:50) and templates per kind. Up to 100 rooms per call; needs approval. Undo: Ctrl+Z or delete the returned view ids.

rooms.description: Room ids (strings). Alternatively use level or all.

level.description: Every placed room of this level (name or id).

all.description: Every placed room of the document (default false).

kinds.description: What to create per room: plan (floor plan cropped to the room) and/or elevations (interior elevations). Default both.

directions.description: Interior elevations by the direction the camera looks to (north = +Y, east = +X). Default all four.

padding.description: Margin around the room for crops, in mm (default 300).

planScale.description: Scale denominator of the room plans (default 50 = 1:50).

planTemplate.description: View template name or id for the room plans.

elevationTemplate.description: View template name or id for the elevations.

planViewFamilyType.description: Floor plan view type name or id. Omit for the default floor plan type.

elevationViewFamilyType.description: Elevation view type name or id (e.g. an interior elevation type). Omit for the default.

planNamePattern.description: Plan name pattern; tokens {number}, {name}, {level}. Default "{number} - {name}". Collisions get " (2)".

hostPlan.description: Plan (name or id) that hosts the elevation markers when no room plan is created. Default: a floor plan of the room's level.

continueOnError.description: false (default): any failure rolls back everything. true: failed rooms are listed in failed[] and the rest kept.

tools.name: create_rooms
tools.description: Create rooms on a level: at given plan points (mm) with name/number, or automatically in every closed circuit (walls + room separation lines) with optional name and sequential numbers. Rooms that already exist are skipped by default. Each room is read back with its area (m²) and whether it is enclosed; dryRun lists the circuits it would fill. One Ctrl+Z undoes the call.

mode.description: points: one room per item point. all_circuits: a room in every closed circuit of the level (walls + separation lines).

level.description: Level by name or id.

phase.description: Phase by name or id. Default: the project's last phase (where new construction usually goes).

items.description: points mode: the rooms to create.

point.description: A plan point in mm inside the area the room should fill.

x.description: X coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

y.description: Y coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

name.description: Room name (e.g. "Sala").

number.description: Room number (e.g. "101"). Omit to let Revit number it.

name.description: all_circuits mode: name given to every new room (optional).

numberPrefix.description: all_circuits mode: prefix for the numbers (e.g. "1" gives 101, 102... with startNumber 1 and digits 2).

startNumber.description: all_circuits mode: first sequential number. Omit to let Revit number the rooms.

digits.description: all_circuits mode: minimum digits of the sequential part (zero padded). Default 2.

skipExisting.description: Skip circuits/points that already have a room in that phase. Default true.

tools.name: create_schedule
tools.description: Create a schedule (regular, material takeoff, key, sheet list or view list) for a category in any language, with fields in order (heading, hidden, width mm, alignment, totals), filters (eq, neq, gt/gte/lt/lte in mm/m2/m3/deg, contains, begins_with, ends_with, has_value...), sorting/grouping (header, footer, blank line), itemization and grand total. Fields are resolved before anything is created; returns the definition read back. Undo: Ctrl+Z or delete the returned schedule id.

name.description: Schedule name, unique among schedules (e.g. "Tabela de Portas").

kind.description: regular (default), material_takeoff, key, sheet_list or view_list.

category.description: Category in any language (OST_Doors, Doors, Portas). Required except for sheet_list/view_list. "OST_MultiCategory" for a multi-category schedule.

fields.description: Fields in column order. Reference them language-neutrally with builtIn/guid when possible (see get_schedulable_fields).

parameter.description: Field to add: {builtIn} (e.g. ROOM_AREA, language-neutral), {guid} (shared parameter) or {name} as listed by get_schedulable_fields ("Count", "Área", ...).

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

fieldType.description: Disambiguates fields with the same parameter: Instance, ElementType (alias: type), Count, Room, FromRoom, ToRoom, Material, MaterialQuantity, ProjectInfo... (see get_schedulable_fields).

hidden.description: Hide the column (it still works for filters and sorting). Default false.

widthMm.description: Column width on the sheet (paper size). Unit: mm.

total.description: Show totals for this column (only numeric fields that can be totalled). Default false.

filters.description: Filters (AND, at most 8) over fields listed in fields[] (hidden ones included).

field.description: Field already in the schedule (it may be hidden): {name: column heading or field name} | {builtIn} | {guid}.

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

op.description: Operator. Numbers are compared in wire units (mm, m2, m3, deg).

value.description: Value to compare with (not used by has_value/has_no_value). Number in wire units, text, true/false, or a level/phase name for element fields.

sort.description: Sorting/grouping levels, in order, over fields listed in fields[].

field.description: Field already in the schedule: {name: column heading or field name} | {builtIn} | {guid}.

guid.description: Shared parameter GUID. Wins over builtIn and name.

builtIn.description: BuiltInParameter enum name, e.g. ALL_MODEL_INSTANCE_COMMENTS. Language-neutral.

name.description: Parameter name as shown in Revit (in Revit's language). Fails with AMBIGUOUS_PARAMETER if two parameters share it.

header.description: Show a group header row. Default false.

footer.description: Show a group footer (title, count and totals). Default false.

blankLine.description: Blank line after each group. Default false.

itemized.description: Itemize every instance (default true). false groups identical rows (needs sort).

grandTotal.description: Show a grand total row (default false).

skipUnknownFields.description: false (default): an unknown or ambiguous field fails the call and nothing is created. true: such fields are skipped and listed in skippedFields.

tools.name: create_section_view
tools.description: Create vertical building sections from a line in plan (start/end in mm). The section looks to the left of start->end by default (lookTo:right flips it), spans the line's length, goes from level + bottomOffset up by height and sees farClipDepth mm beyond the cut. The resulting view direction and crop are read back. Optional name, type, scale (50 = 1:50), detail level, template. Undo: Ctrl+Z or delete the returned view ids.

items.description: Sections to create, up to 50 per call.

start.description: Start of the section line in plan (mm, project internal origin).

x.description: X coordinate in mm (project internal origin).

y.description: Y coordinate in mm (project internal origin).

end.description: End of the section line in plan (mm). The line sets the width of the section.

x.description: X coordinate in mm (project internal origin).

y.description: Y coordinate in mm (project internal origin).

lookTo.description: Which side of the line start->end the section looks at: left (default; drawn west->east it looks north) or right.

level.description: Reference level for bottomOffset (name or id). Omit for the lowest level.

bottomOffset.description: Bottom of the section relative to the reference level, in mm (default -1000).

height.description: Height of the section from its bottom, in mm (default 6000).

farClipDepth.description: How far the section sees beyond the cut line, in mm (default 5000).

name.description: Section name (must be free among sections). Omit for Revit's default name.

viewFamilyType.description: Section view type name or id. Omit for the default section type.

template.description: View template name or id to assign.

continueOnError.description: false (default): any failure rolls back all sections. true: failed ones are listed in failed[].

tools.name: create_sheets
tools.description: Create sheets in batch (real or placeholder): number, name, title block ("Family: Type", default title block if omitted), extra parameters and optional views/schedules placed at x/y in mm. Numbers are checked for forbidden characters and collisions (also within the request) before anything is created; names are read back. One transaction (one Ctrl+Z); all or nothing unless continueOnError. Undo: Ctrl+Z, or delete the returned sheet ids.

items.description: Sheets to create, up to 200 per call.

number.description: Sheet number, unique in the document (e.g. "A-101").

name.description: Sheet name (e.g. "Planta Baixa - Térreo").

titleBlock.description: Title block type as "Family: Type", type name or id. Omit for the document's default title block; "none" for no title block.

placeholder.description: Create a placeholder sheet (listed in sheet lists, not printed; no title block or views). Default false.

parameters.description: Extra sheet parameters by name, e.g. {"Desenhado por": "AE"}; same value rules as set_parameters.

views.description: Views or schedules to place on the new sheet.

view.description: View or schedule to place, by name or id.

x.description: Centre of the viewport on the sheet, from the sheet origin (bottom-left of most title blocks). Unit: mm.

y.description: Centre of the viewport on the sheet, from the sheet origin. Unit: mm.

continueOnError.description: false (default): any failure rolls back every sheet of the call. true: failed sheets are skipped and listed in failed[].

tools.name: create_text_note
tools.description: Create text notes in a view or sheet (batch): text, position in the view plane in mm (plans: model X/Y; sections/elevations: horizontal coordinate and elevation), text type by name, wrap width in paper mm, rotation in degrees and alignment. One transaction, all or nothing. Returns the note ids and positions read back. Undo: Ctrl+Z or delete the returned ids.

view.description: View or sheet to place the notes in (name or id).

text.description: Text of the note (\n for line breaks).

position.description: Insertion point in the view plane (mm). Plans: model X/Y; sections/elevations: horizontal coordinate and elevation; sheets/drafting: sheet/view coordinates.

x.description: Horizontal coordinate in the view plane. Plans: model X. Unit: mm.

y.description: Vertical coordinate in the view plane. Plans: model Y; sections/elevations: elevation Z. Unit: mm.

textType.description: Text type name or id (e.g. "2.5mm Arial"). Default: the document's default text type.

widthMm.description: Wrap width on paper (as printed). Omit for a single line that grows with the text. Unit: mm.

rotationDeg.description: Rotation in the view plane, counter-clockwise (default 0). Unit: deg.

vAlign.description: Vertical alignment relative to the insertion point (default top).

tools.name: create_view
tools.description: Create views in batch: floor_plan, ceiling_plan, structural_plan, area_plan (needs a level), isometric 3d and drafting views, with optional name, view family type, scale (100 = 1:100), detail level, view template and scope box. Scale/detail are set before the template; every value is read back. Sections, elevations and callouts: create_section_view, create_elevation_view, create_callout_view. One transaction (one Ctrl+Z); all or nothing unless continueOnError. Undo: Ctrl+Z or delete the returned view ids.

items.description: Views to create, up to 100 per call.

viewType.description: Kind of view: floor_plan, ceiling_plan, structural_plan, area_plan, 3d (isometric) or drafting. Sections, elevations and callouts have their own tools.

name.description: View name (must be free among views of the same type). Omit to keep Revit's default name.

level.description: Level name or id. Required for plans; ignored for 3d and drafting.

viewFamilyType.description: View family type name or id (e.g. "Planta de piso"). Omit for the document's default type of that kind.

areaScheme.description: Area scheme name or id, for area_plan (e.g. "Gross Building"). Omit when the document has only one.

scale.description: Scale denominator: 100 means 1:100. Set before the template is applied.

template.description: View template name or id to assign (must be compatible with the view type).

scopeBox.description: Scope box name or id to crop the view (plans and 3D only).

continueOnError.description: false (default): any failure rolls back every view of the call. true: failed views are skipped and listed in failed[].

tools.name: create_view_filter
tools.description: Create a rule-based view filter: categories in any language and parameter rules (builtIn/guid/name; eq, neq, gt/gte/lt/lte with numbers in mm/m2/m3/deg, contains, begins_with, ends_with and negations, has_value/has_no_value) combined with and/or. The parameter must be common to all the categories. ifExists error/reuse/update. Optionally applies it to a view or template with visibility and overrides. Undo: Ctrl+Z or delete the filter.

name.description: Filter name, unique among filters.

categories.description: Categories the filter applies to, in any language (OST_Walls, Walls, Paredes).

rules.description: Parameter rules (up to 20). Omit for a category-only filter.

parameter.description: Parameter common to every category of the filter: {builtIn} (language-neutral), {guid} (shared) or {name} as Revit shows it.

tools.name: create_walls
tools.description: Create walls by segment, polyline (open or closed) or rectangle, coordinates in mm. The wall type must be named (never defaulted); height is either a top level (+topOffset) or an unconnected height. locationLine says which face/centreline sits on the points (e.g. finishFaceInterior to draw the inner outline of a room); closed shapes put the exterior face outside. Returns ids, lengths and the read-back constraints. One Ctrl+Z undoes the call.

y.description: Y coordinate in mm from the project's internal origin.

baseLevel.description: Base level by name or id.

exteriorSide.description: Closed shapes only: put each wall's exterior face outside the outline (default), inside it, or keep Revit's side from the drawing direction.

flip.description: Swap the exterior and interior faces of every wall of this item (applied after exteriorSide). Default false.

structural.description: Create structural walls. Default false (architectural partitions).

joinEnds.description: Let the walls join at their ends (corners). Default true.

tools.name: dimension_elements

The dimension line is computed perpendicular to the targets (or given in the view plane in mm). Returns the dimension id and each segment value in mm, read back. Not for 3D views. Undo: Ctrl+Z or delete the returned id.

view.description: Plan, section or elevation view (name or id). Not 3D views: Revit accepts the call there but draws nothing.

targets.description: 2 to 50 parallel elements to dimension, in any order (a chain dimension with one segment per gap).

element.description: Wall, grid, reference plane or family instance id.

side.description: Which reference: walls exterior (default) | interior face; family instances centerLeftRight (default) | centerFrontBack | left | right | front | back. Ignored for grids and reference planes.

line.description: Dimension line in the view plane. Default: perpendicular to the targets, at offsetMm from the first target's midpoint.

start.description: Start of the dimension line in the view plane (mm).

y.description: Vertical coordinate in the view plane. Plans: model Y; sections/elevations: elevation Z. Unit: mm.

end.description: End of the dimension line in the view plane (mm).

x.description: Horizontal coordinate in the view plane. Plans: model X. Unit: mm.

y.description: Vertical coordinate in the view plane. Plans: model Y; sections/elevations: elevation Z. Unit: mm.

offsetMm.description: Default line only: distance along the targets' direction from the first target's midpoint (model mm, default 0).

dimensionType.description: Linear dimension type name or id. Default: the document's default.

tools.name: duplicate_sheet
tools.description: Duplicate a sheet 1-20 times: same title block type and (copyParameters) its writable values, legends and schedules at the same positions, sheet annotations (text, generic annotations, detail lines/components, images, detail groups) and optionally the placed views duplicated (duplicate / with_detailing / as_dependent) and placed at the same centres with the same viewport type. Numbers given or "<source>-1"...; works the same on Revit 2022-2026. Needs approval. Undo: Ctrl+Z.

names.description: Sheet names of the copies (one per copy). Omit to keep the source name.

copyRevisions.description: Copy the manually assigned revisions (default false).

tools.name: duplicate_type
tools.description: Duplicate a type (loadable family type, wall/floor/roof type, text or dimension style, group type...) under a new name, optionally setting type parameters on the copy (wire units mm, m2, m3, deg, %; read back). ifExists=reuse returns the existing type of that name instead of failing. The original and its instances are not touched. Returns the new type id. Undo: Ctrl+Z.

tools.name: duplicate_view
tools.description: Duplicate views or schedules: option duplicate, with_detailing or as_dependent (checked with CanViewBeDuplicated first), count copies each, named newName (single copy) or prefix + source name + suffix (collisions get " (2)"). Returns the new view ids with their names read back. Undo: Ctrl+Z or delete the returned ids.

tools.name: execute_batch
tools.description: Runs several tool calls against one document as a single atomic change: one Ctrl+Z undoes the whole batch. Every step is validated before anything runs; UI steps can't be mixed with model changes and only batchable tools are accepted (max 200 steps). Use "$steps[i].path" in args to pass a value from an earlier step (e.g. "$steps[0].changes.created[0]"). With dryRun the batch runs and is rolled back, returning what would change. The approval risk of a batch is the highest risk among its steps. Returns per-step results plus the combined change set.

stopOnError.description: When true (default), the first failing step rolls the whole batch back. When false, failing steps are skipped (their own changes rolled back) and the others are kept.

tools.name: export_cad
