merge.description: true (default): keep the filter's current overrides and change only what is given. false: replace them.

tools.name: set_view_properties
tools.description: Change view properties on up to 200 views: scale (100 = 1:100), detailLevel, displayStyle, discipline, phase, phaseFilter, and newName for a single view. Every value is read back and returned as before/after; properties locked by a view template are reported as blocked with the template name. Atomic by default. Undo: Ctrl+Z, or call again with the 'before' values.

displayStyle.description: Visual style: wireframe, hidden_line, shaded, shaded_with_edges, consistent_colors, realistic.

discipline.description: View discipline: architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing or coordination.

phase.description: Phase name or id shown by the view.

phaseFilter.description: Phase filter name or id (e.g. "Show All" / "Mostrar tudo").

newName.description: Rename the view (only with a single view). Must be free among views of its type.

atomic.description: true (default): any property that doesn't stick rolls the whole call back. false: the rest is kept and failures are reported per view.

tools.name: set_view_range
tools.description: Set the view range of plan views: top, cut, bottom and viewDepth, each {level, offset mm} where level is a level name/id, "current", "above" or "unlimited". Unspecified parts are kept. Elevations are checked top >= cut >= bottom >= depth before writing; plans whose range is controlled by a view template are refused with the template name. Returns old and new ranges. Undo: Ctrl+Z.

views.description: Plan views (names or ids), up to 200.

level.description: Level the plane is measured from: a level name or id, "current" (the view's level, default), "above" (level above) or "unlimited" (top/depth only).

offset.description: Offset from that level, in mm (default: keep the current offset).

cut.description: Cut plane (e.g. offset 1200 from the current level).

level.description: Level the plane is measured from: a level name or id, "current" (the view's level, default), "above" (level above) or "unlimited" (top/depth only).

offset.description: Offset from that level, in mm (default: keep the current offset).

level.description: Level the plane is measured from: a level name or id, "current" (the view's level, default), "above" (level above) or "unlimited" (top/depth only).

offset.description: Offset from that level, in mm (default: keep the current offset).

viewDepth.description: View depth plane (must be at or below bottom).

level.description: Level the plane is measured from: a level name or id, "current" (the view's level, default), "above" (level above) or "unlimited" (top/depth only).

offset.description: Offset from that level, in mm (default: keep the current offset).

atomic.description: true (default): any view that fails rolls the whole call back. false: failures are reported per view.

tools.name: set_view_temporary_visibility
tools.description: Control what a view shows, by elements or categories: isolate_temp / hide_temp (Temporary Hide/Isolate, cleared with reset_temp or by closing the view: handy to show the user what a plan will touch), hide / unhide (permanent, only in that view; undo with unhide or Ctrl+Z), show_attached_groups / hide_attached_groups for model groups. Category changes are refused when a view template controls visibility. Temporary operations are skipped in dryRun (only validated). Default view: the active one.

operation.description: isolate_temp / hide_temp (temporary hide/isolate, not saved with the view), reset_temp (end temporary hide/isolate), hide / unhide (permanent, in this view only), show_attached_groups / hide_attached_groups (attached detail groups of model groups).

elementIds.description: Element ids (strings: id or UniqueId). For *_attached_groups: the model group ids.

categories.description: Categories (any language) instead of / besides elements: isolate_temp/hide_temp/hide/unhide act on the whole category.

view.description: View name or id. Default: the active view (target must be the active document).

tools.name: set_wall_base_top
tools.description: Set the base and top of walls: base level + offset, top level + offset or "unconnected" with a height (all in mm, levels by name or id), and attach/detach the top or base to floors, roofs or ceilings (attach needs Revit 2025+). Checks that the top stays above the base for every wall before changing anything, reads every value back and returns before/after per wall. Changing the base level moves hosted elements with the wall. Undo: Ctrl+Z.

baseOffset.description: Base offset from the base level. Unit: mm.

topLevel.description: Top constraint level (name or id), or "unconnected" to use unconnectedHeight.

topOffset.description: Top offset from the top level. Unit: mm.

unconnectedHeight.description: Height when the top is unconnected. Unit: mm.

attach.description: Attach the top or base to a floor/roof/ceiling (Revit 2025 or newer).

side.description: top or base of the wall.

targetId.description: Floor, roof, ceiling (or other valid target) to attach to / detach from. For detach, omit to detach every target on that side.

detach.description: Detach the top or base (Revit 2025 or newer).

side.description: top or base of the wall.

targetId.description: Floor, roof, ceiling (or other valid target) to attach to / detach from. For detach, omit to detach every target on that side.

tools.name: setup_project_levels
tools.description: Declarative project level setup: describe the floors (name + finished elevation in mm) and the tool derives finished (AC), structure (ES = AC - finishThickness) and ceiling (FO = AC + ceilingHeight) levels plus site levels, compares them with the model and returns a plan per level: create, adjust (elevation), rename, keep, extra or remove. Run with dryRun first to show the plan. Removing levels deletes their views and hosted elements and needs removeUnlisted + confirmRemove. One Ctrl+Z undoes the call.

floors.description: Floors (pavimentos) from bottom to top with their finished elevation.

name.description: Floor (pavimento) name used in the level names, e.g. "Térreo", "Pavimento Tipo", "Cobertura".

finishedElevation.description: Finished floor elevation (AC, piso acabado) in mm.

code.description: Optional code for {code} in nameTemplate (e.g. "N01"). Default: the floor's position, 2 digits.

kinds.description: Which levels each floor gets. Default [finished, structure, ceiling] (AC, ES, FO).

finishThickness.description: Floor finish build-up in mm: structure level = finished - finishThickness. Required when kinds include structure.

ceilingHeight.description: Ceiling height above the finished floor in mm: ceiling level = finished + ceilingHeight. Required when kinds include ceiling.

labels.description: Labels for {kind} in nameTemplate. Default AC / ES / FO.

structure.description: Label of the structure (top of slab) level (default "ES").

nameTemplate.description: Level name pattern with {floor}, {kind}, {code} and {index} (1-based, 2 digits). Default "{floor} - {kind}". Follow the office naming (get_office_knowledge).

siteLevels.description: Extra levels used as is: terrain, sidewalk (calçada), platforms.

name.description: Level name, used as is (e.g. "Terreno", "Calçada").

adoptByElevation.description: Rename an unmatched existing level that sits at a wanted elevation (±1 mm) instead of creating a duplicate (e.g. the template's "Nível 1"). Default true.

removeUnlisted.description: Plan to delete existing levels that are not in the setup. Default false (they are reported as extra and kept).

confirmRemove.description: Required to actually delete levels (and the views and elements hosted on them). Without it a plan with removals is refused outside dryRun.

createPlanViews.description: Create a floor plan for finished levels and a ceiling plan for ceiling levels when missing. Default true.

tools.name: show_elements
tools.description: Show elements to the user in Revit: optionally activates the given view and zooms to the elements there (with a margin), otherwise lets Revit pick a view that shows them (it may open one); selects them by default. Active document only; does not change the model. Elements not visible in the chosen view are reported.

elementIds.description: Elements to show, by id or UniqueId (strings), 1-1000.

view.description: View to show them in (name or id). Default: Revit picks a suitable view (may open one).

marginPercent.description: With view: extra margin around the elements when zooming, 0-500 % of their extent (default 20).

tools.name: tag_all_in_view
tools.description: Tag every element of the given categories (any language) visible in a view, skipping the ones already tagged (local and linked tags detected). Rooms, areas and spaces get their own tags. Optional tag type per category, leader, orientation, elementIds and a limit per call. Elements that cannot be tagged are reported, not fatal. Use dryRun to see the counts first. Returns counts per category and the created tag ids. Undo: Ctrl+Z.

view.description: View to tag in (name or id): plan, ceiling plan, area plan, section, elevation or locked 3D view.

categories.description: Categories to tag, in any language (OST_Doors, Doors, Portas, OST_Rooms...).

tagTypes.description: Tag type per category, e.g. {"OST_Doors": "M_Door Tag: Standard"}. Categories not listed use their default tag.

skipTagged.description: Skip elements that already have a tag in this view (default true).

elementIds.description: Only these elements (ids) among those visible in the view.

limit.description: Maximum tags to create in this call, 1-5000 (default 1000). Run again to continue.

tools.name: tag_elements
tools.description: Tag specific elements in a view (any category; rooms, areas and spaces get room/area/space tags; elements of Revit links via "linkInstanceId:elementId"). Optional tag type ("Family: Type"), leader, orientation and placement in the view plane (mm) or offset. Skips already-tagged elements by default. One transaction; all or nothing unless continueOnError. Returns created tag ids. Undo: Ctrl+Z or delete the returned ids.

view.description: View to tag in (name or id): plan, ceiling plan, section, elevation or locked 3D view.

element.description: Element to tag: id, UniqueId, or "linkInstanceId:elementId" for an element inside a Revit link.

tagType.description: Tag type as "Family: Type", type name or id. Omit for the category's default tag.

orientation.description: horizontal (default), vertical or model (follows the element).

point.description: Where to put the tag, in the view plane (mm). Default: the element's location point, curve middle or bounding-box centre.

x.description: Horizontal coordinate in the view plane. Plans: model X. Unit: mm.

y.description: Vertical coordinate in the view plane. Plans: model Y; sections/elevations: elevation Z. Unit: mm.

offsetX.description: Shift from the default point along the view's horizontal direction (model mm).

offsetY.description: Shift from the default point along the view's vertical direction (model mm).

skipTagged.description: Skip elements that already have a tag in this view (default true).

continueOnError.description: false (default): any failure rolls back every tag of the call. true: failed items are listed in failed[] and the rest is kept.

tools.name: transform_elements
tools.description: Move, copy, rotate or mirror elements in one transaction. Distances and points in mm, angles in degrees. rotate defaults to a vertical axis through the centre of the elements; mirror takes a plane (origin + normal) or a grid / reference plane / line element. copy:true keeps the originals for rotate/mirror. Pinned elements are refused (unpin with set_elements_pinned). Returns the ids of new copies and the read-back locations. Undo: Ctrl+Z.

elementIds.description: Elements to transform.

operation.description: move (by vector), copy (copies moved by vector), rotate (angle about an axis), mirror (across a plane or a line element).

vector.description: Displacement for move / copy, in mm.

x.description: X coordinate (project internal origin). Unit: mm.

y.description: Y coordinate (project internal origin). Unit: mm.

z.description: Z coordinate (project internal origin). Unit: mm.

angle.description: Rotation angle for rotate, counter-clockwise seen from the axis direction. Unit: deg.

axisOrigin.description: A point on the rotation axis, in mm. Default: centre of the elements' combined bounding box.

x.description: X coordinate (project internal origin). Unit: mm.

y.description: Y coordinate (project internal origin). Unit: mm.

z.description: Z coordinate (project internal origin). Unit: mm.

axisDirection.description: Direction of the rotation axis. Default vertical (0,0,1).

dx.description: X component of the direction (any scale).

dy.description: Y component of the direction (any scale).

dz.description: Z component of the direction (any scale).

mirrorPlane.description: Mirror plane for mirror: origin + normal.

origin.description: A point on the mirror plane, in mm.

x.description: X coordinate (project internal origin). Unit: mm.

y.description: Y coordinate (project internal origin). Unit: mm.

z.description: Z coordinate (project internal origin). Unit: mm.

normal.description: Normal of the mirror plane (e.g. {dx:1,dy:0,dz:0} mirrors across a plane parallel to YZ).

dx.description: X component of the direction (any scale).

dy.description: Y component of the direction (any scale).

dz.description: Z component of the direction (any scale).

mirrorLineElementId.description: Alternative to mirrorPlane: a grid, reference plane or line element; mirrors across the vertical plane through it.

copy.description: rotate / mirror: transform copies and keep the originals. Default false.

tools.name: warnings_delta
tools.description: Track warnings across a work session: operation baseline saves the current warnings (per document, to a file in Documents\RevitMCP\qa), and operation delta reports which warnings are new and which were resolved since then, grouped by warning type, with element ids. Run baseline before a change and delta after it to prove the change introduced no warnings. Does not change the model.

operation.description: baseline: snapshot the current warnings to a file (replaces the previous baseline of that name); delta: compare the current warnings with the baseline.

baselineName.description: Name of the baseline (letters, digits, - and _; default "default"). Baselines are per document.

limit.description: Delta: new/resolved warnings listed per page, 1-1000 (default 100).

offset.description: Delta: items to skip in the new/resolved lists (default 0).
